what_is_wrong: 13 of 182 published books have a file_url that returns 403 Access Denied, so teachers can't open or download them. All 13 are the media.base44.com/files/public/<app>/files/wordwise/... paths (Wordwise teacher guides, workbooks and session banks for tiny_roots/little_sprouts/little_wonders/pre_primary, plus the Lighthouse Manual and 9 Picture-Word Worksheets). The flip book's fallback iframe then shows the error page.
how_you_saw_it: Node fetch from the Base44 sandbox against every published file_url: 168 returned 200 application/pdf with %PDF- magic bytes; 13 returned 403 on both HEAD and ranged GET (x-cache: Error from cloudfront). IDs are in library_ids.json broken_file_url.
proposed_fix: Re-upload the 13 PDFs through the normal UploadFile path (base44.app/api/apps/.../files/mp/public/...) and update file_url. Alternatively fix permissions on the /files/wordwise/ prefix. Copies are in the Finniped Library bundle: source_path wordwise/<band>/...

what_is_wrong: The body-safety gate was lost when HeartWise hw1 replaced the old books. 12 archived HeartWise records had safeguarding_gated=true and audience=teacher_parent_only (Pre-Primary and Bright Bloomers workbook, teacher guide, picture cards, session bank). Their 8 hw1 successors are all safeguarding_gated=false, and the workbooks are audience=child. All 1,440 placements are ungated, including the body-safety sessions HW-PP-S088, HW-BB-S094 and HW-LW-S094 ('My body belongs to me', 'My body is mine: keeping safe'), whose child_workbook pages have audience=child.
how_you_saw_it: jq over FinnipedResource: archived Heartwise with safeguarding_gated=true is 12, and their superseded_by targets have gated=false. FinnipedPlacement: safeguarding_gated=true is 0 of 1440. Lists: library_ids.json safeguarding_gate_lost_in_hw1, hw1_successors_now_ungated, body_safety_placements_ungated.
proposed_fix: Have the safeguarding lead confirm the policy. Then set safeguarding_gated=true (and audience teacher_parent_only where appropriate) on the body-safety placements, and on any hw1 book whose body-safety pages must not reach child/parent surfaces. Add a check to the importer so gate and audience carry over from the records listed in replaces.

what_is_wrong: Choosing an age band hides every cross-band book. The filter `if (band && r.band !== band) return false` drops records with band=''. So a teacher who picks their band loses 38 published all-band books: Numenature Start Here, the Concept and Curriculum Guide, 12 Concept Books, Assessment, Maths Games, Poster Packs, Wordwise Decodable Readers, the Lighthouse Manual and Treasure Books.
how_you_saw_it: Code read, line 70. Data: 38 published records have band='' and band_label 'All bands / birth–6'.
proposed_fix: Change the filter to `if (band && r.band && r.band !== band) return false`, so cross-band books stay visible (optionally in an 'All ages' group). Don't assign fake bands to genuinely cross-band books.

what_is_wrong: 38 published records have no band. The 20 Numenature v3 guides and concept books and the Wordwise/Lighthouse readers are genuinely cross-band (label 'All bands / birth–6'). The 10 Treasure Books and 3 Numinature Step One records come from 'Toddlers' source folders and may belong to a band.
how_you_saw_it: jq: status=published and band=='' gives 38 (Numenature v3 20, Treasure Books 10, Numinature Step One 3, Wordwise 3, Wordwise Lighthouse 2).
proposed_fix: Leave the cross-band ones empty and fix the filter (see L-03). For Treasure Books and Numinature Step One, confirm with the author. The low-confidence proposed_band is in library_ids.json published_no_band.

what_is_wrong: The band doesn't match the age in the title. The band follows the series level number rather than the age range: e.g. 'Bodywise Movement Workbook 02 Toddlers 1-2y' is little_sprouts (2–3y), 'Bodywise ... 05 Kindergarten 4-5y' is pre_primary (5–6y), and 'Artelier ... 04 Pre-KG 3-4y' is bright_bloomers (4–5y). Teachers filtering by band get content pitched a year off.
how_you_saw_it: Title age range compared with band_label for published Bodywise/Artelier records. Wonderwild, Lifecraft and Forestwise are consistent.
proposed_fix: Decide whether band means series level or child age. If it means age, remap per library_ids.json published_band_title_age_mismatch.proposed_band. Note this would leave Bodywise with no pre_primary book, and tiny_roots with two levels.

what_is_wrong: 14 published books have oversized=true (up to 620 pp / 16.2 MB: Wordwise Session Lesson Banks, the Decodable Readers x2, the Lighthouse Manual, Numinature Step One). FlipBook uses pdfjs disableAutoFetch:false, so it downloads the whole file, and books over 400 pages open in the plain iframe, which shows only the first page on iOS.
how_you_saw_it: jq oversized=true and status=published = 14. Code: src/fws/components/FlipBook.jsx:19 FLIP_LIMIT=400, :137 disableAutoFetch:false.
proposed_fix: Split the oversized books as the schema note says (>20MB or >150pp). In FlipBook, set disableAutoFetch:true with range requests (the server supports 206).

what_is_wrong: Favourites do follow a replaced book: the shelf walks superseded_by up to 5 hops, and every archived record except the test one has a valid superseded_by pointing at a published record. But the card on the shelf shows the replacement and checks isFav(replacement.resource_id), which is false. So the star shows empty, tapping it adds a second favourite, and the old favourite can never be removed from the UI. The tab count uses favourites.length (raw rows), not shelf.length.
how_you_saw_it: Code read. superseded_by: 125 set, 0 dangling, 0 pointing to non-published. FinnipedFavourite query returned 0 rows (RLS is created_by_id, so the service query may only see its own), so no live orphan count was possible.
proposed_fix: When rendering the shelf, pass the original favourite id: treat isFav true if any favourite resolves to this resource, and remove that row on toggle. Optionally, migrate favourite rows to the successor's resource_id when the switch-over runs. Use shelf.length for the tab count.

what_is_wrong: The shelf ignores visibility rules. A favourite whose book is now draft, or has no successor, is still shown, and a missing book falls back to the denormalised favourite row with its old file_url. Gated books aren't filtered for non-staff there either.
how_you_saw_it: Code read: shelf builds from favourites without applying the `visible` filter.
proposed_fix: Apply the same status and safeguarding checks to shelf items. Show a 'no longer available' state instead of a stale link.

what_is_wrong: Hiding drafts, archived books, proposed placements and safeguarding-gated books happens only in the browser. RLS read is {} on both entities, so any signed-in user (any role) can list every draft, archived and gated record and its file_url through the SDK.
how_you_saw_it: list_entity_schemas: FinnipedResource rls.read={}, FinnipedPlacement rls.read={}. Code: FinnipedLibrary.jsx:63-68 filters client side.
proposed_fix: Add read RLS: status=='published' for non-admin roles (e.g. $or [{status:'published'},{user_condition:{role:'admin'}},{user_condition:{role:'super_admin'}}]). The same applies to placements with status 'published'. Gated content needs a staff-role condition.

what_is_wrong: Archived books are correctly hidden from non-admins (status!=='published' is dropped at line 65), and from admins in the default view (line 68). No issue here. Minor gap: nothing hides necessity='unnecessary' AND necessity_approved=true books from non-super-admins, as the schema describes (0 published records affected today).
how_you_saw_it: Code read. Data: published with necessity unnecessary = 0.
proposed_fix: Add `if (r.necessity==='unnecessary' && r.necessity_approved && role!=='super_admin') return false;` to the visible filter.

what_is_wrong: The contents list and the page jump only work in flip mode. go() returns early when pfRef is null, so in plain/fallback mode (books over 400 pages, or after a PDF.js error) contents clicks do nothing. The fallback iframe also gives no error message: status 'error' is set but never rendered, so a 403 file (L-01) shows a blank or XML page.
how_you_saw_it: Code read. FlipBook.jsx:203 `if (!pf) return;`. status==='error' is not used in the JSX.
proposed_fix: In plain mode, make go() update `current` (the iframe src already uses #page=current+1). Render an error state ('This book could not be opened – try Download / tell an admin') when both the PDF.js load and a HEAD check fail.

what_is_wrong: The download buttons use `<a download>` on a cross-origin URL (base44.app redirecting to media.base44.com). Browsers ignore the download attribute cross-origin, so 'Download' just opens the PDF in the same tab and navigates away from the app.
how_you_saw_it: Code read. The fetch shows a redirect to media.base44.com with no Content-Disposition header.
proposed_fix: Fetch the file as a blob and save it with an object URL, or add target=_blank. The Print button already opens a new tab.

what_is_wrong: A load error looks the same as an empty library. The catch sets resources to [] and the page shows 'Nothing matches'. The page also loads all 440 records with full contents arrays (about 800 KB JSON) on every visit.
how_you_saw_it: Code read. The query_entities full result was 804,471 chars.
proposed_fix: Keep an error state with a retry button. Fetch published only for non-admins (filter({status:'published'})) and a slim field list, and load contents lazily in the reader.

what_is_wrong: The 'By curriculum week' tab uses only linked_week_ids and ignores FinnipedPlacement. None of the 39 HeartWise hw1 books and 24 of 60 Numenature v3 books have linked_week_ids, so HeartWise is missing from this tab even though it has 720 placements with month and week.
how_you_saw_it: jq: published Heartwise linked=false 39; Numenature linked=false 24.
proposed_fix: Build the by-week view from FinnipedPlacement (band + month + week_in_month → resource + page_from), and open the reader at page_from. Or run the week linker for hw1/v3.

what_is_wrong: The placements are clean. There are 1,440 in total: 720 HeartWise (hw1) plus 720 Numenature (v3), 5 bands x (108 session_plan + 36 child_workbook) each. what_is_wrong: HEAD requests to base44.app/api/apps/.../files/... intermittently return 404 application/json instead of redirecting (1 of 182 on the first pass; 2 of 3 retries on the same URL), while GET always works. Link checkers and any HEAD-based pre-check will report false failures.
how_you_saw_it: Node fetch: the same URL alternated HEAD 404 / 200 / 404; GET 200 application/pdf 356,433 bytes.
proposed_fix: Use GET with a Range: bytes=0-4 header for health checks. Report the flake to Base44 if HEAD is relied on.
